programme.title: Ibsen
programme.desc: Max Faber's 1953 adaptation of the play by Henrik Ibsen that, over three days in the summer of 1888, follows a lighthouse-keeper's daughter who is trapped in her marriage and longing for the sea.

programme.title: The Australian Wars
programme.desc: Although the Australian Wars began with the British Government, the founding fathers of modern Australia conclude it, with northern Australia the war's final frontier.

programme.title: British History's Biggest Fibs with Lucy Worsley
programme.desc: Lucy debunks the fibs that surround the `jewel in the crown' of the British Empire, India. Travelling to Kolkata, she investigates how the Raj was created following a British government coup in 1858.

programme.desc: Simon Schama begins his history of Britain by tracing the islands' development from prehistoric times to the Norman invasion. He visits Skara Brae in Orkney - a miraculously preserved settlement dating from the third millennium BC - and discusses the 400-year Roman occupation, King Alfred's defeat of the Vikings and the unification of England, and the Norman invasion.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.sub-title: Dylan's Walks: New Quay and Laugharne
programme.desc: Derek Brockway travels to the seaside town of New Quay on Cardigan Bay where Dylan Thomas and his wife Caitlin lived during the war. He is joined by guide Jeff Towns to learn why the couple's time there was so dramatic and how it inspired some of Thomas's greatest work.

programme.title: The Secret Genius of Plants
programme.desc: Technical developments are enabling people to see the world of plants in ever greater detail, giving insight into their remarkable abilities to adapt and survive.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: The story of a giant otter cub, who was rescued and is being raised by Brazilian naturalist Carolina Vargas. Sancho has to be bottle-fed, shown how to catch fish, and taught to outsmart the many predators of the Pantanal, the world's biggest wetland.

programme.title: Tribe
programme.desc: Bruce Parry treks into the jungles of Sarawak, Borneo in search of the last nomadic Penan. The Penan are hunter-gatherers whose forest home is in the process of being cut down around them and whose traditional way of life is about to disappear forever.

programme.title: Bernard Hill Remembers...Boys from the Black Stuff
programme.desc: Actor Bernard Hill, who famously played the character of Yosser Hughes, reflects on the iconic drama series `Boys from the Black Stuff'.

programme.title: Boys From the Blackstuff
programme.desc: An astute social commentary about life in recession-hit Britain in the Thatcher era. Chrissie, Dixie, Yosser, Loggo and George sign on at the benefit office before heading off for some short-term work for the builder Malloy. The conversion job turns out to be the future new offices of the DHSS. Unfortunately, DHSS officials Moss and Lawton suspect their scam and are determined to catch them in the act.

programme.title: Boys From the Blackstuff
programme.desc: Dixie Dean, working at night in the port as a security guard, is strongarmed into accepting bribes for allowing the removal of goods under his charge in a docked ship. Chrissie, Loggo and George, the other members of the original gang, meet up prior to Snowy Malone's funeral.
